notes: DEVELOPMENT BALANCE, revision 5 (2026-10-02). Owner's schedule (docs/21 §dev-5): first ascension (L5) at the end of week one for both pacing types, L10 monthly, L20 at 2-3 months, L50 at 3-6 months, L100 at 6-12 months. 100 levels. Levers: daily_activity_xp_cap 40 across all families (consistency, not volume, sets the pace), goal_xp 30/20/12, quest 10/15/25, session_base_xp 15, 30-min taper kept from dev-4. Thresholds derived by Tools/derive_level_curve.py from the light persona at 75 % goal completion so that L5=day 7, L10=30, L20=60, L50=150, L100=300; heavy lands at 5/20/40/99/197. Still a fixture until TestFlight data.

daily_taper.notes: Per family, per local day. Minutes above full_credit_minutes earn taper_rate; minutes above hard_cap_minutes earn 0. History is still logged. dev-4: 30 min full credit so that daily consistency, not session length, sets the pace (docs/21 targets).

day_boundary.notes: An event belongs to the local calendar day of its started_at. Sessions crossing midnight are not split in dev-1.

structured_workout.notes: Structured strength sessions are often logged after the fact in under a minute. The user confirms a session length at finish (default_minutes when not logged live); credit is max(duration, valid sets x minutes_per_valid_set), capped, then the daily taper applies.

daily_quest.notes: Doc 24. 4 h (owner, 2026-10-02). Unlocks when every goal of the day is done. dev-5: XP 10/15/25 at 60/30/10.
